svg.text: 18650 cell -> IP5306 boost/charge module -> ESP32 VIN. A divider reads the battery on GPIO33. USB cable NOT plugged in.
GPIO33 sees half the cell voltage
Charging: remove the 5V+ wire to the ESP32,
then plug a charger into the Type-C port.
Never connect USB and the 5V+ wire together.
K pad: leave free (touch to GND ~1 s only to wake).
Wires that cross without a black dot are NOT connected.
ESP32 pins are shown grouped by use, not in board order.
